subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search intentionally fail closed when `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` is an unavailable SecretRef even if `OLLAMA_API_KEY` exists, and should the four new resolver hooks become part of the exported provider web-search SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sound, but changing an existing credential fallback and expanding a public plugin API are compatibility choices that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt shared fail-closed policy
options.body: Land the additive hooks and block ambient credential substitution whenever an explicitly configured Ollama SecretRef is unavailable.

options.title: Preserve ambient compatibility
options.body: Revise the integration so an unavailable configured SecretRef may still fall back to `OLLAMA_API_KEY`, retaining the prior upgrade behavior.

options.title: Narrow the SDK expansion
options.body: Keep the Ollama repair but avoid exposing all four hooks publicly until the permanent external plugin contract is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Land the additive hooks and block ambient credential substitution whenever an explicitly configured Ollama SecretRef is unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shared SecretRef policy and the affected Ollama credential-selection path.
